title: Front desk clutter (staffed) · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Staffed check-in pod clutter for a 1.08 m top (origin at the pod's floor center, guests at +Z): key-card encoder with a card in it, thermal receipt printer with a receipt curling out, card terminal on a swivel stand, call bell, lathed apples in a bowl, Wi-Fi tent card, registration card, key-card sleeves, ballpoints in a steel cup, succulent, mug, stapler, sticky note. Pick-up-able items are take_* nodes. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/). Meters, Y up, origin at floor center, front faces +Z. 2026-11-21: Dana’s keyboard (legends toward the staff side) and mouse in front of the monitor; their touch spots (where hands go, what a key sounds like) are in projects/roadside-inn/affords.js.
